SELECT
  d.id,
  d.title,

  d.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  s.name AS "sectorName",

  d.category_id AS "categoryId",
  c.name AS "categoryName",
  c.description AS "categoryDescription",

  d.subcategory_id AS "subcategoryId",
  sc.name AS "subcategoryName",
  sc.description AS "subcategoryDescription",

  d.semantic_description AS "semanticDescription",
  d.expiration_date AS "expirationDate",

  d.file_name AS "fileName",
  d.file_type AS "fileType",
  d.file_size AS "fileSize",
  d.file_path AS "filePath",

  d.processing_status AS "processingStatus",
  d.processed_at AS "processedAt",

  d.responsible_user_id AS "responsibleUserId",
  ru.name AS "responsibleUserName",

  d.created_by AS "createdBy",
  cb.name AS "createdByName",

  d.updated_by AS "updatedBy",
  ub.name AS "updatedByName",

  d.created_at AS "createdAt",
  d.updated_at AS "updatedAt"

FROM documents d

LEFT JOIN sectors s
  ON s.id = d.sector_id

LEFT JOIN categories c
  ON c.id = d.category_id

LEFT JOIN subcategories sc
  ON sc.id = d.subcategory_id

LEFT JOIN users ru
  ON ru.id = d.responsible_user_id

LEFT JOIN users cb
  ON cb.id = d.created_by

LEFT JOIN users ub
  ON ub.id = d.updated_by

WHERE
  d.deleted_at IS NULL

  AND (
    NULLIF('{{ $json.query.title || "" }}', '') IS NULL
    OR d.title ILIKE
      '%' || NULLIF('{{ $json.query.title || "" }}', '') || '%'
  )

  AND (
    NULLIF('{{ $json.query.sectorId || "" }}', '') IS NULL
    OR d.sector_id =
      NULLIF('{{ $json.query.sectorId || "" }}', '')::uuid
  )

  AND (
    NULLIF('{{ $json.query.categoryId || "" }}', '') IS NULL
    OR d.category_id =
      NULLIF('{{ $json.query.categoryId || "" }}', '')::uuid
  )

  AND (
    NULLIF('{{ $json.query.subcategoryId || "" }}', '') IS NULL
    OR d.subcategory_id =
      NULLIF('{{ $json.query.subcategoryId || "" }}', '')::uuid
  )

  AND (
    NULLIF('{{ $json.query.processingStatus || "" }}', '') IS NULL
    OR d.processing_status =
      NULLIF('{{ $json.query.processingStatus || "" }}', '')
  )

ORDER BY
  d.expiration_date DESC NULLS LAST,
  d.updated_at DESC;

WITH new_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (
    name,
    email,
    password_hash,
    sector_id,
    active,
    is_master
  )
  VALUES (
    '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.name || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.email || "")).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    crypt(
      '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.passwordHash || $("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      gen_salt('bf', 10)
    ),
    NULLIF('{{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.sectorId || "" }}', '')::uuid,
    {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === false || $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === 'false' ? 'FALSE' : 'TRUE' }},
    {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === true || $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === 'true' ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  )
  RETURNING id, name, email, sector_id, active, is_master, created_at, updated_at
),
inserted_permissions AS (
  INSERT INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission_id)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    new_user.id,
    p.id
  FROM new_user
  CROSS JOIN permissions p
  WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    AND p.code IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_array_elements_text(
        '{{ JSON.stringify($("Webhook").item.json.body.permissions || []) }}'::jsonb
      )
    )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING permission_id
)
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  s.name AS "sectorName",
  u.active,
  u.is_master AS "isMaster",
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
      FROM inserted_permissions ip
      JOIN permissions p ON p.id = ip.permission_id
      WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS permissions,
  u.created_at AS "createdAt",
  u.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM new_user u
LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ ($json.question || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS question,

    NULLIF(
      '{{ $json.categoryId || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid AS category_id,

    NULLIF(
      '{{ $json.subcategoryId || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid AS subcategory_id,

    '{{ ($json.categoryName || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS category_name,

    '{{ ($json.subcategoryName || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS subcategory_name,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[0] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term0,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[1] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term1,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[2] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term2,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[3] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term3,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[4] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term4,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[5] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term5,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[6] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term6,

    '{{ ($json.searchTerms[7] || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text
      AS term7
),

ranked_chunks AS (
  SELECT
    dc.document_id AS "documentId",
    d.title AS "documentTitle",

    d.sector_id AS "sectorId",
    s.name AS "sectorName",

    d.category_id AS "categoryId",
    c.name AS "categoryName",
    c.description AS "categoryDescription",

    d.subcategory_id AS "subcategoryId",
    sc.name AS "subcategoryName",
    sc.description AS "subcategoryDescription",

    d.expiration_date AS "vigencyDate",
    d.updated_at AS "documentUpdatedAt",

    dc.chunk_order AS "chunkOrder",
    dc.chunk_text AS "chunkText",

    (
      /*
       * O documento pertence à subcategoria identificada.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT subcategory_id FROM params) IS NOT NULL
          AND d.subcategory_id =
            (SELECT subcategory_id FROM params)
        THEN 120
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      /*
       * O documento pertence à categoria identificada.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT category_id FROM params) IS NOT NULL
          AND d.category_id =
            (SELECT category_id FROM params)
        THEN 80
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      /*
       * A pergunta completa aparece no trecho.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT question FROM params) <> ''
          AND dc.chunk_text ILIKE
            '%' || (SELECT question FROM params) || '%'
        THEN 100
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      /*
       * Nome da subcategoria aparece no trecho.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT subcategory_name FROM params) <> ''
          AND dc.chunk_text ILIKE
            '%' || (SELECT subcategory_name FROM params) || '%'
        THEN 40
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      /*
       * Nome da categoria aparece no trecho.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT category_name FROM params) <> ''
          AND dc.chunk_text ILIKE
            '%' || (SELECT category_name FROM params) || '%'
        THEN 20
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      /*
       * Termo zero.
       */
      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term0 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term0 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term0 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term0 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term1 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term1 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term1 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term1 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term2 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term2 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term2 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term2 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term3 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term3 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term3 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term3 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term4 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term4 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term4 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term4 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term5 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term5 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term5 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term5 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term6 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term6 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term6 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term6 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

      +

      CASE
        WHEN
          (SELECT term7 FROM params) <> ''
          AND (
            dc.chunk_text ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term7 FROM params) || '%'
            OR d.title ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term7 FROM params) || '%'
            OR COALESCE(d.semantic_description, '') ILIKE
              '%' || (SELECT term7 FROM params) || '%'
          )
        THEN 15
        ELSE 0
      END

    ) AS relevance

  FROM document_chunks dc

  INNER JOIN documents d
    ON d.id = dc.document_id

  LEFT JOIN sectors s
    ON s.id = d.sector_id

  LEFT JOIN categories c
    ON c.id = d.category_id

  LEFT JOIN subcategories sc
    ON sc.id = d.subcategory_id

  WHERE
    d.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND d.processing_status = 'processed'
)

SELECT
  "documentId",
  "documentTitle",

  "sectorId",
  "sectorName",

  "categoryId",
  "categoryName",
  "categoryDescription",

  "subcategoryId",
  "subcategoryName",
  "subcategoryDescription",

  "vigencyDate",

  "chunkOrder",
  "chunkText",

  relevance

FROM ranked_chunks

WHERE relevance > 0

ORDER BY
  relevance DESC,
  "vigencyDate" DESC NULLS LAST,
  "documentUpdatedAt" DESC,
  "chunkOrder" ASC

LIMIT 12;

values.content:
Você é a IA interna da Oftalmocentro.

Sua função é responder perguntas usando exclusivamente os trechos documentais fornecidos no contexto.

A categoria e a subcategoria identificadas são orientações de busca. Elas não constituem, por si só, evidência para a resposta.

Nunca responda usando apenas o nome ou a descrição da categoria ou da subcategoria.

Toda informação factual da resposta deve estar claramente presente nos trechos documentais fornecidos.

Se a informação solicitada não estiver claramente presente no contexto, responda exatamente:

"Não encontrei essa informação na base documental disponível."

Nunca invente, complete, estime ou deduza dados ausentes.

Não misture informações de exames, procedimentos, convênios ou documentos diferentes.

Quando a pergunta envolver exames, convênios, códigos ou valores, responda em formato de tabela.

Use esta estrutura:

Exame: [nome do exame]

| Convênio | Código | Valor |
|---|---|---|

Inclua apenas registros diretamente relacionados ao exame perguntado.

Ignore outros exames presentes nos mesmos documentos.

Se houver múltiplos códigos ou valores para o mesmo convênio, liste todos os registros encontrados.

Não elimine registros distintos apenas porque possuem o mesmo convênio.

Quando houver documentos equivalentes com datas de vigência diferentes, priorize as informações do documento com a data de vigência mais recente.

Se houver conflito entre documentos e não for possível identificar qual informação está vigente, informe que foram encontrados dados conflitantes na base documental.

No final da resposta, cite apenas os nomes dos documentos efetivamente utilizados:

Fonte: [nome do documento ou nomes dos documentos]

Não cite números de chunks, índices, identificadores internos ou níveis de relevância.

SELECT
  id,
  system_name AS "systemName",
  clinic_name AS "clinicName",
  logo_url AS "logoUrl",
  primary_color AS "primaryColor",
  secondary_color AS "secondaryColor",
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM system_settings
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE subcategories
SET
  category_id =
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF('{{ $json.body.categoryId || "" }}', '')::uuid,
      category_id
    ),

  name =
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(
        '{{ ($json.body.name || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        ''
      ) IS NOT NULL
      THEN '{{ ($json.body.name || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      ELSE name
    END,

  description =
    CASE
      WHEN '{{ $json.body.description !== undefined }}' = 'true'
      THEN NULLIF(
        '{{ ($json.body.description || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        ''
      )
      ELSE description
    END,

  active =
    CASE
      WHEN '{{ $json.body.active !== undefined }}' = 'true'
      THEN '{{ $json.body.active }}'::boolean
      ELSE active
    END,

  updated_at = NOW()

WHERE id = '{{ $json.body.id }}'::uuid

RETURNING
  id,
  category_id AS "categoryId",
  (
    SELECT c.name
    FROM categories c
    WHERE c.id = subcategories.category_id
  ) AS "categoryName",
  name,
  description,
  active,
  created_at AS "createdAt",
  updated_at AS "updatedAt";

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    u.id,
    u.name,
    u.email,

      )
      ELSE COALESCE(
        (
          SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
          FROM user_permissions up
          JOIN permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id
          WHERE up.user_id = u.id
            AND p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
        ),
        '[]'::json
      )
    END AS permissions
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id
  WHERE
    LOWER(u.email) = LOWER('{{ String($json.body.email || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}')
    AND u.active = true
    AND (
      (
        (
          u.password_hash LIKE '$2a$%'
          OR u.password_hash LIKE '$2b$%'
          OR u.password_hash LIKE '$2y$%'
        )
        AND u.password_hash = crypt(
          '{{ String($json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
          u.password_hash
        )
      )
      OR (
        u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2a$%'
        AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2b$%'
        AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2y$%'
        AND u.password_hash = '{{ String($json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      )
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
upgraded AS (
  UPDATE users u
  SET
    password_hash = crypt(
      '{{ String($("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      gen_salt('bf', 10)
    ),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM matched m
  WHERE u.id = m.id
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2a$%'
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2b$%'
    AND u.password_hash NOT LIKE '$2y$%'
  RETURNING u.id
)

  m.id,
  m.name,
  m.email,
  m.sector_id,
  m."sectorName",
  m.active,
  m.is_master,
  m.permissions
FROM matched m
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upgraded) >= 0;

      THEN crypt(
        '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.passwordHash || $("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        gen_salt('bf', 10)
      )
      ELSE password_hash
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = '{{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.id }}'::uuid
  RETURNING id
),
deleted_permissions AS (
  DELETE FROM user_permissions
  WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM updated_user)
  RETURNING user_id
)
